_readme: Tree's taste thresholds, read by scripts/social/check-drafts.mjs (and lib/photo-reuse.mjs, lib/lessons.mjs callers) via scripts/social/lib/strategy-params.mjs. Tree owns this file: edit it by PR, put the evidence for the change in that section's `why`, report it in the weekly plan; Marjorie's weekly Fable review keeps, reverts or adjusts it. Lands without a founder merge. NOT here, and not switchable from here: the founder-owned guardrails in docs/social/guardrails.md (credit, rights, platform limits, the approval stamp). A missing or invalid field falls back to the built-in default, which equals the pre-2026-10-01 behaviour. `mediaKind: "card"` also needs lib/queue-schema.mjs to list it (posting-path PR) before a card draft clears validate-queue.

media.why: 2026-10-01 S2 baseline, equal to the prior hard-coded gate plus `card` (owner: Tree decides cards/pictures/other; a card is a committed PNG rendered from /api/share-card, credited "Long Live", never lyrics).

siteScreen.why: 2026-10-01 S2 baseline: the 2026-08-31 audit found site-screen on 7 of the last 10 posted IG items (social/posted/); kept as a launch-only carousel behind a Taylor photo until Tree has evidence to widen it.

photoReuse.why: 2026-10-01 S2 baseline: lesson L001 (6 firings, social/lessons.md) - a photo may repeat only across the IG and X halves of one campaign; the IG-history window is the last 10 posted IG items.

photoMix.why: 2026-10-01 S2 baseline: advisory only (a warning, never a failure) when fewer than 70% of the last 10 posted IG items were mediaKind photo and this draft is not one either; the 2026-08-12 Taylor-photo standard made photos the default.

pairing.why: 2026-10-01 S2 baseline: owner 2026-08-25/2026-09-10 'one idea goes out to X, Instagram... all together'; a per-item singlePlatformReason is still the one exemption.

openers.why: 2026-10-01 S2 baseline: formula openers were the 2026-08-11 audit's top voice finding; the first-6-words match runs against the last 14 days of posts and the queue.

crossPost.why: 2026-10-01 S2 baseline: the 2026-08-10 TTPD pair scored ~0.89 word overlap and plausibly drew X's duplicate-content 403; below 0.8 the X copy reads as its own.

xLength.why: 2026-10-01 S2 baseline: a self-imposed headroom warning under X's 280 weighted limit (the 280 limit itself is a guardrail and not tunable).

lessons.why: 2026-10-01 S2: promoting a rejection lesson into a hard gate after 3 firings is now Tree's explicit choice per lesson (set true to restore the old automatic `codify:` issue), not an automatic ratchet.
